datasetIds.title: Datasets to merge
datasetIds.description: Pick one or more datasets (for example the outputs of several scraper runs). They are read in this order.

items.title: Items (JSON, optional)
items.description: Instead of (or in addition to) datasets, pass items directly. Useful when calling the Actor through the API.

fileUrls.title: Files by URL (CSV, TSV, JSON, JSON Lines)
fileUrls.description: Public links to files to merge, e.g. a CSV export or a JSON file. Downloaded once (max 100 MB each). CSV delimiter (comma, semicolon, tab, |) is detected automatically. For Excel, export the sheet as CSV first.

fileFormat.title: File format
fileFormat.description: Leave on auto unless detection guesses wrong.

dedupFields.title: Deduplicate by fields
dedupFields.description: Two items are duplicates when all of these fields are equal, e.g. ["url"] or ["name", "address.city"]. Dotted paths reach nested fields. Leave empty to compare whole items.

keep.title: Which duplicate to keep
keep.description: first = keep the earliest (fastest, lowest memory). last = keep the newest. mostComplete = keep the copy with the most non-empty fields.

normalizeKeys.title: Ignore case and extra spaces when comparing
normalizeKeys.description: "ACME Inc " and "acme inc" count as the same value. Output values are not changed.

ignoreUrlTracking.title: Treat URLs that differ only by tracking parameters as equal
ignoreUrlTracking.description: Ignores utm_*, fbclid, gclid, #fragments, trailing slash and leading www. when comparing.

filters.title: Keep only rows matching (all conditions)
filters.description: List of {"field", "op", "value"}. op: eq, neq, contains, notContains, exists, notExists, gt, gte, lt, lte, regex. Example: [{"field":"price","op":"lt","value":100},{"field":"email","op":"exists"}]

fieldsToKeep.title: Output only these fields
fieldsToKeep.description: Leave empty to keep all fields.

fieldsToOmit.title: Remove these fields
fieldsToOmit.description: Fields to drop from every item.

renameFields.title: Rename fields
renameFields.description: Map of old name to new name, e.g. {"title": "name"}.

flattenNested.title: Flatten nested objects (CSV/Excel friendly)
flattenNested.description: {"address":{"city":"Paris"}} becomes {"address.city":"Paris"}. Arrays of values are joined with "; ".

addSourceField.title: Add source dataset ID to each item
